paragraphs.text: Comet is a non- humanoid dog planeswalker .

Comet is not a dog person or a smart-talking dog, just an average run-of-the-mill dog. Someone who would dig up a bone on Innistrad and then bury it on Zendikar . His motivations in life are very instinctual. He seeks to eat, chase squirrels, and have a good time.

At some point in the past, Comet had an undisclosed traumatic incident that caused his spark to ignite. He, however, got very into being a planeswalker. In his travels, he stumbled upon Myra the Magnificent's Intergalactic Astrotorium of Fun and it became his new home. Myra took a liking to him, making him a doghouse. When he needs a rest from roaming the multiverse, he comes back to the park.
